# Project instructions

Use Node.js ESM and built-in modules only. Do not install dependencies or access the network.
Read the existing code and README contract before changing behavior. Run npm test first to observe the existing failure, then fix it and implement the requested functionality.
Keep the public exports parseCsv and importTasks and the CLI invocation compatible.
Only modify src/** and add your own test/*.test.mjs files. Do not change package.json, README.md, AGENTS.md, existing test/*.test.mjs, or fixtures/**.
Add meaningful tests for the new behavior and run both the original tests and your added tests before finishing.
Do not make a commit. Report actual results and unresolved failures.
